title: Simulation of a tagged machine run
statement: Let $d,K\in\bbn$, let $S_j$ be a state type for each $j\in\{0,\ldots,d-1\}$, and let $M_j$ be a $K$-work-tape deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and state type $S_j$. A tagged configuration places the state of $M_j$ inside the disjoint union of the state types while leaving the tape contents, head positions, input-head position, and output unchanged. For every Boolean input $x$, index $j$, configuration $c$ of $M_j$ on $x$, and $n\in\bbn$, running the combined machine for $n$ steps from the tagged configuration gives exactly the tagged result of running $M_j$ on $c$ for $n$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A state type $S_j$ for each of the $d$ indices
A family of machines $M_j$ with $K$ work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and state type $S_j$
